dataList.content:
We have to go through here if we want to take the fastest path to Tiekan Temple.
要去铁槛寺的话，从这里走是最快的捷径。
dataList.place:
Way Down to Tiekan Temple
通往铁槛寺之路

dataList.content:
<Looks like it leads underground... >
<看来我们得下到地下去了……>

Oh man... are you sure this is the fastest path? The heck are they doing over there?
哎呦……真的是捷径吗？那是什么？

Well, seems to me that's exactly why they're here, blocking our way.
如果是捷径，那率先派人拦路也不奇怪吧。

Well, I never thought it was going to be easy...
好吧，倒是在意料之中……

Looks like I was right.
从一开始就不太顺利啊。

Stop right there. Turn around and leave, now.
我建议你们掉头原路返回。

You're the ones who are committing this tantrum of a treason because you just can't accept that you lost.
不接受既定的结果，肆意举起反旗的家伙们……

Besides, what do you mean 'retake the Hierarch'? It's not like you ever took her from us.
我们有什么好夺回的？本来也没被夺走啊。

You can't even proudly speak the name of your master.
此外，你甚至不能提及你主人的名字。

It would have been the first thing you announced if you believed your cause to be just. Your very actions are those of a thief.
如果有正当的名分，那么不必别人询问也一定会自报家门。这说明他自己都认为自己做的是小偷的行径啊。

... Hah, and why would we need to announce our cause for a ragtag band like yours?
